**Daily Devotional**

**April 7**

*4 Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: 5 And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might. (Deuteronomy 6:4-5 KJV)*

This is true, but us humans have a hard time understanding the fact that our God is one Lord, and yet is manifested in numerous ways, like Father, Son and Holy Ghost. The church has chosen to call this the Trinity, as the three are one. I am not so sure that God does not actually manifest Himself in more then these three ways, as John wrote in the book of Revelation that before the Throne of God were the Seven Spirits of God (Revelation 4:5).

This verse is still for us believers in Christ, that we are commanded to love the Lord our God with all our heart, soul and might. God gives us His love in the fruit of the Spirit that born again believers receive (Galatians 5:22-23). If you ever get hold of just how much our God loves us, then it is easy to return that love. God’s love is beyond our ability to understand (Ephesians 3:19), and if you are ever overcome with His love, you will have the peace and joy that He means for all Christians to have. It is overwhelming, but so very wonderful. There is no peace or joy in this world that can come close to that which comes from God, as He is love (1 John 4:8). Try it you’ll like it. All you have to do is study the Word of God until it gets on the inside of you, in your heart, and the joy and peace will come automatically, if you will walk after the Spirit. Praise God for His love.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
